India-Australia ties 'never been more consequential', says Australian PM

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese stated that the relationship between India and Australia has "never been more consequential." This statement was made ahead of an upcoming visit by Prime Minister Modi to Australia. The remarks highlight the growing importance of the bilateral relationship.
